_comment: 0G DA configuration for InjectMe L3 rollup

da_server._comment: HTTP sidecar that bridges OP Stack to 0G DA network

disperser._comment_port: gRPC endpoint that the DA server connects to via --zg.server

batcher._comment: Controls how the DA client batches and encodes blobs for submission.

contracts._comment_entrance: DAEntrance on 0G Galileo testnet. Handles blob submission fees and routing.
contracts._comment_signers: DASigners precompile. Fixed address on all 0G chains.

da_encoder._comment: Rust-based encoder that performs erasure coding on blobs
da_encoder._comment_params: Encoder parameters must be downloaded via dev-support/download_params.sh

network._comment_blob: Max blob size in bytes. 32.5 MiB = 34078720 bytes.
network._comment_epoch: Number of L1 blocks per DA epoch. ~5760 blocks at 12s = ~19.2 hours.

da_node._comment: Reference config for running your own DA node (optional, for self-hosting)
